name: serene-pub-sdk
description: The Serene Pub pipeline SDK — four packages a plugin author builds against.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @serene-pub/sdk && npm run build -w @serene-pub/contracts -w @serene-pub/conformance && npm run build -w @serene-pub/docs && npm run build -w @serene-pub/cli && npm run build -w @serene-pub/core-catalog && npm run docs:api && npm run docs:examples && npm run build -w @serene-pub/playground
scripts.docs:examples: cd sdk-tests && tsx ../cli/src/bin.ts docs --examples examples --goldens examples/goldens --out ../docs/generated/examples
